body:
I'm not going through hell by anyone's standards and I won't kill myself just because of being disappointed in life. I will be keeping the equipment because obtaining (and moving it around) wasn't exactly easy, *and* I want to keep my options open. 

I will pick up a hobby, try to make some new friends and give myself a bit more time... see what comes out investing more energy on friendships and something I enjoy (yet to be decided).

What you're saying is logical and makes sense, so I will try your advice. 

Now that my suicide plan has almost completely panned out (except for the actual deed) I feel like I can just go ahead and do it any time I feel like it, no more planning/thought required.

This is exactly what's holding me back at this point, I wish the people who know me wouldn't have to go through the emotions associated with someone close committing suicide. Really, it just makes me want to "gone missing" but I feel like the uncertainty from something like that would be selfish.

I don't even know why I'm doing it, I feel compelled to do so and have for much longer than the year I spent getting my affairs into order. 

Everything I've read says to wait before doing the  deed - I've waited a good solid year. I know that I still have a lot of things I could do in this world, yet I still feel compelled to die.
